description:
A conspiracy led by a selected few, freed from the hands of death after being infected by the vampire syndrome. After successfully establishing their world secretly, they became the most powerful entities by having control not only of the police but also of politics and the media. People who knew of their existence called them “The Afters”. Meanwhile, Tae-Su Dan, who had lost everything due to them, forms a strong team for his revenge. Having established his team, Tae-Su heads to “Red table”, a prison camp for bloodbags, to rescue Dam Yi, the bloodbag with the best blood on Earth. How will Tae-Su Dan carry out his revenge? And will he and his friends succeed?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

 *Note: Includes a prologue*
